text: Beauty Marks is the seventh studio album by American singer Ciara, released on May 10, 2019, through her independent label Beauty Marks Entertainment, with distribution handled by Alternative Distribution Alliance. It marks her first album since Jackie (2015). The album was preceded by five singles: "Level Up," "Freak Me," "Dose," "Greatest Love," and "Thinkin' Bout You." After Jackie (2015), Ciara left Epic Records in early 2016; although the album produced the Platinum-certified single "I Bet," it had limited commercial success, selling approximately 160,000 copies worldwide within three months. Ciara had planned to promote Jackie with a second leg of the Jackie Tour in March 2016, but on February 27, 2016, she announced the tour's cancellation and announced her focus on recording her seventh studio album, signaling a new musical direction. On January 27, 2017, Ciara signed a new recording contract with Warner Bros. Records, during which she worked on her seventh album and released the lead single "Level Up" with a music video in 2017. Creative tensions arose between Ciara and Warner Bros. over the release of "Level Up," prompting Ciara to take control of her artistic vision. After meeting with the label's CEO and being denied approval for her project, she requested her masters back, and Warner Bros. returned them for free. In 2017, Ciara founded Beauty Marks Entertainment (BME) to maintain creative control and release music on her own terms, with plans to sign additional artists. BME's first singles were "Level Up," "Freak Me," and "Dose," released in 2018, and Ciara officially announced the label on February 7, 2019, at the MAKERS Conference. On March 28, 2019, Ciara announced the album would be titled Beauty Marks and released on May 10, 2019, with pre-orders available the next day and the fifth single, "Thinkin' Bout You," released simultaneously. Ciara stated that she now feels like she did at the beginning of her career, excited to live her dreams. She co-wrote the title track "Beauty Marks" with Skylar Grey. "Level Up" was released on July 18, 2018, as the lead single, peaking at No. 59 on the US Billboard Hot 100 and No. 23 on the US Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart, and inspired the viral "level up dance challenge"; it was certified Platinum by the RIAA. The second single, "Freak Me" featuring Nigerian rapper Tekno, was released on August 10, 2018, and peaked at No. 22 on the US R&B/Hip-Hop Digital Songs Chart. "Dose" was released as the third single on September 14, 2018, after premiering on ESPN’s Monday Night Football halftime show, with its music video premiering on October 25, 2018 (Ciara's 33rd birthday), and it peaked at No. 7 on the US R&B Digital Songs Sales chart. The fourth single, "Greatest Love," was released with its music video on February 11, 2019, to coincide with Valentine's Day, and peaked at No. 21 on the US R&B Digital Songs Sales chart. "Thinkin' Bout You" was released as the fifth single on March 29, 2019, with its music video premiering the same day, peaking at No. 20 on the US R&B/Hip-Hop Digital Songs Chart. A music video for the title track was released on May 11, 2019, and one for the third track, "Set," on June 14, 2019; despite not being released as a single, the title track peaked at No. 22 on the R&B Digital Songs Sales chart. Beauty Marks received generally mixed reviews; at Metacritic, it received an average score of 57 based on four reviews. Andy Kellman of AllMusic noted Ciara "retreads just about every move she has made before" and praised the ballads for outperforming the up-tempo tracks, which were not as strong as her previous dancefloor hits. Alfred Soto of Spin called the album "mediocre" but said it "lands in the middle of Ciara's discography when boldness is required." Nick Levine gave it 3 out of 5 stars, stating that while the album is rarely innovative, Ciara shows a respectable range. Eric Torres of Pitchfork said the album is "marred by filler," moving between frothy pop-R&B and stale empowerment anthems that underuse Ciara's talents. Steven J. Horowitz praised the album's themes of happiness and contentment, saying they suit Ciara well and reflect her newfound openness. The album debuted at No. 87 on the US Billboard 200 and No. 48 on the Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums chart, and as of May 2019, has sold over 135,000 equivalent album units globally. All songs were written by Ciara, with additional writers noted below. The Beauty Marks Tour, Ciara's fifth concert tour, supported the album and was announced on June 1, 2019, during a performance on Good Morning America. Joey Guerra of the Houston Chronicle reviewed the Houston date and said every song was a "renewed blast of energy," noting the performance remained "an intoxicating sound" regardless of whether the songs were from her early or latest work.
